title: haptic-nerve-feedback: skin-bypassing haptic feedback via electrical nerve stimulation
description: An open research project developing skin-bypassing haptic feedback: electrical stimulation of afferent nerves (no mechanical actuators) that the brain perceives as touch. Staged development from a single-finger neural haptic ring toward whole-hand (wrist-level) and, long-term, spine-level stimulation, targeting applications in VR/AR, prosthetics, robot teleoperation, and virtual labs.
